title: phaseoloides erianthum
intro: Phaseoloides erianthum, commonly known as the wild yam, is a plant species that belongs to the Dioscoreaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties that help to alleviate menstrual cramps and other symptoms associated with PMS. The therapeutic actions of Phaseoloides erianthum include its ability to relax muscles and reduce pain, making it an effective treatment for conditions such as arthritis and fibromyalgia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diosgenin, a steroid saponin that has been shown to have estrogen-like effects and is used in hormone replacement therapy.
